title: Towards evaluating and building versatile large language models for medicine

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Towards evaluating and building versatile large language models for medicine》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We evaluate nine leading LLMs, e.g., MEDITRON, Llama 3, Mistral, GPT-4, Claude-3.5, etc. and found that most models struggle with these complex tasks.
